name: Christopher Staples
office: Norwalk-La Mirada Unified School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 6

items.text: Christopher Staples is a former member of the Norwalk-La Mirada Unified School District board, serving from 2020 to 2024 and as board president in 2022. In 2025, he chaired the district's Measure G Citizens' Bond Oversight Committee. His campaign says he serves on the Greater Whittier YMCA board and the district's Leadership Academy Design Team. He was president of the La Mirada Chamber of Commerce from 2006 to 2007.

items.text: In 2023, as board president, he voted against bylaws establishing the powers of student board members; the measure passed.
